items.text: Hello everyone!
Today we have several exciting updates to share with you, including the release of our next DLC, the beginning of our Online Multiplayer Closed Beta, and a little surprise for Formula E fans.
We're thrilled to announce the upcoming release of the Historic Tracks Pack for Formula Legends.
This DLC is dedicated to the evolution of Formula racing and brings three iconic circuits inspired by legendary motorsport venues, each recreated across different eras of racing history.
San Marino Motorsports Park – Classic & Modern Variations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/d4b8a834c449136375dfff66b6154f383c4948e6.png"]
Dutch Dunes Circuit – Classic & Modern Variations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/387be30ae0db0361c8235c8e43a3f8e59f645e5f.png"]
Hatchwood Circuit – Vintage & Classic Variations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/ae4862e7197f00ae3a5a55cba357f347707a8e1b.png"]

Each version offers its own personality and challenge. From fast and unforgiving historic layouts to more refined modern configurations, you'll experience how these circuits evolved over the decades while mastering technical corners, sweeping elevation changes, and high-speed sections that defined generations of racing.
That's not all.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/0667be09f1353355e3863d8695f8f8ab578e1ccb.png"]
To celebrate the release of the Historic Tracks Pack, we've decided to create a brand-new Modern Hatchwood layout and make it available for free to every Formula Legends player.
What IF - Formula Legends will race in some other circuits ? Write in the comment your best What IF ?

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Closed Beta Starts June 30

items.text: We're also excited to announce that the first phase of our Online Multiplayer Closed Beta is about to begin.
While there are still a few important features and improvements we want to complete before releasing multiplayer to the wider community, the mode is now ready for its first real-world testing phase.
Starting on June 30, we'll be sending out the first 100 beta keys to selected players.
fter we will share more wave of keys
If you'd like to participate, head over to our Discord server, where you'll find the application form and all the details needed to join the Closed Beta.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/8d2ad3ddecf80b320581ad4dddf4ee5444e4c1d0.png"]
Your feedback will play a crucial role in helping us improve and polish the online experience before its full release.

notes.title: A Small Surprise for Formula E Fans

items.text: Before we wrap up, we also have something planned for everyone who owns the Formula E DLC.
At the end of July, we'll be releasing a small free bonus update that we think Formula E enthusiasts are going to appreciate.
We're not quite ready to reveal the details yet, but stay tuned, we'll have more to share soon.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/b1487f2d27382f9d3c14d5a4ec578dedfd163c8d.png"]
As always, thank you for your continued support, feedback, and enthusiasm.
The last few months have been incredibly important for Formula Legends, and we're excited to finally start putting some of these new features and content into your hands.
We look forward to seeing you on track, whether you're racing through the history of Formula racing, testing the first online sessions, or discovering what's coming next.
See you on the grid!

Hello everyone, and welcome back to Formula Legends.
On March 12, we’re releasing the Late ’20 Season DLC alongside Patch 1.4.
This update introduces the 2026 season, featuring a new generation of cars built around brand-new
regulations that significantly change how every race is approached.
It’s a major step forward for the game and a fresh challenge for all players.
The DLC includes the full 2026 car lineup, designed around the updated technical rules, and a dedicated championship that lets you experience this new era across an entire season.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/ec9b770788dfcc3d1141f672b98b709163535cbd.gif"]
A brand-new track also joins the calendar: Azerbaijan, a fast and technical circuit that highlights both the strengths and challenges of the new generation of cars.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/c97ae5886b0b27e804677e2edb3adf7642c6a216.png"]
If you cross the line within one second of the car ahead, you’ll unlock an Overtake Boost for the following lap.
It can only be used during that lap, adding a new layer of strategy and rewarding close, well-timed racing.

notes.title: The new cars feature a dual aerodynamic system

items.text: A Mode can be activated in specific sections, increasing top speed and acceleration on straights.
B Mode activates automatically, providing more grip and stability through corners.
Managing these modes is key to maximizing performance.
With the 2026 regulations, fuel management has been replaced by battery management, featuring three mappings:
Balance – standard performance and consumption
Performance – higher speed and acceleration, faster battery drain
Eco – reduced performance with improved recharge
Strategy now plays an even bigger role throughout the race.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/e3f73d04676c1afd560a82dafdff9405f6e60953.png"]
To let everyone try the new generation, we’re releasing a free 2026 team: Custom Motors, available in Custom and Time Attack modes even without owning the DLC.
We’re also launching a completely free season: Late ’50s, including a new car, new legends, and a special track: Italy “Super Vintage” variant.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/83a8bad06363356efc07baf053873c0e1d3650fa.png"]

Alongside the new season and recent refinements, and in agreement with the majority of our community, we’ve Reset the online leaderboards 🚨🚨🚨 to provide a fresh start that reflects the current state of the game.
The Late ’20 Season DLC, together with all previous DLCs, will be included in the Legacy Edition, the physical boxed version available starting June 4 by Microids.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/178b5a458e793b578af0bcf70ca12641e0e424ad.png"]
A new season begins!
See you on track, Legends.

items.text: Hello everyone,
We’ve released a new hotfix for Formula Legends addressing an issue related to input device recognition.
After the recent update focused on steering wheel support, some players reported difficulties using a gamepad.

This issue was caused by the game incorrectly identifying certain external peripherals connected to the PC (such as specific mouse models) as steering wheels. As a result, the game assumed a wheel was connected and disabled gamepad input.
With this hotfix, we’ve changed the device recognition method to prevent this forced input lock and allow proper use of gamepads regardless of other connected peripherals.
Please note that, due to this change, minor compatibility issues may occur with specific steering wheel models.
If you experience any anomalies or input-related problems, we invite you to contact us on Discord https://discord.gg/jwAfduUG, where we’ll be happy to help and provide the best possible support.
Hotfix – Input Device Recognition
Fixed an issue where some external peripherals (e.g. specific mouse models) were incorrectly detected as steering wheels
Resolved gamepad input being disabled when a wheel was falsely detected
Updated input device recognition to allow proper gamepad usage regardless of connected peripherals
Note: minor compatibility issues may occur with certain steering wheel models
Introduced new DeadZone setting for Wheels
Fixed force feedback not working after reconnection bug
Fixed Wheel input wrong behavior during tutorial
We’re excited to announce that Formula Legends Patch 1.3 is now live!
This update delivers some of the most requested improvements so far, significantly enhancing the overall driving experience.

Patch 1.3 introduces full steering wheel support with complete input remapping, letting you fine-tune every control for a more precise, realistic, and immersive feel. At launch, wheel models from Moza, Logitech, Fanatec, and Thrustmaster are supported, with additional brands planned for future updates.

notes.title: For the best driving experience, we strongly recommend setting your wheel steering dead zone to 0 in the control settings.

items.text: This ensures correct input response and allows the new wheel handling to work as intended.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/c074bb04eda81af94ffd5ffe84d8f76a002db9dc.png"]
We’ve also rolled out a complete rework of the collision system and hitboxes, making on-track contacts less punishing and improving wheel-to-wheel racing.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/cf6e7cb33dc179a25e1b150ba1a99fddf9365d92.png"]
To further boost immersion, cars now feature a visual damage system, with visible damage and deformation after impacts.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/1968b98602d467951eba7ae552c644c4b0ea914a.png"]
PATCH 1.3 – FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS
Patch 1.3 also includes numerous fixes and quality-of-life improvements across gameplay, controls, audio, and stability.
Improved qualification session timing for more reliable session flow
Rebalanced the Tire Master pilot perk to prevent overpowering while still rewarding smart tyre management
Improved gear shifting behavior for more consistent and responsive changes
Refined vehicle collision boxes to reduce invisible contacts and unexpected side collisions
Improved steering wheel input remapping for easier configuration and better compatibility
Fixed the Depth of Field option so it now behaves correctly and reflects selected values
Improved deadzone behavior and overall force feedback consistency
Reduced excessive force feedback during gear changes
Restored wheel slip feedback and fixed unwanted vibrations
Fixed force feedback turning off in menus or after qualifying
Fixed throttle not always reaching 100% and improved pedal behavior
Restored missing wheel steering options on supported platforms
Fixed tyre selection issues and race timer behavior during pit stops
Improved stability, menus, tutorials, and localisation
Added new audio feedback when a gear can’t be engaged due to RPM limits
Fixed impact and engine audio issues after collisions
Fixed custom camera crashes and visual option inconsistencies

Hello Legends! We have a huge update to share with you: Version 1.1 of Formula Legends arrives, and it’s one of our biggest updates yet.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/623e2a8197c4ebe8341fa5a34d3881d6bf49a334.png"]
New HUD Indicators + Fully Customizable Interface

This update expands the in-race information you have at your disposal by introducing three new indicators: delta time, last lap, and fastest lap. These additions give you better feedback during every stint and help make each race feel more competitive.

The user interface also becomes far more flexible. Every HUD element can now be turned on or off individually, letting you choose exactly what you want to see and how clean or detailed your screen should be.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/7955289d724515dcfca152452c614b772f4c75a5.png"]
Improved AI Strategy + new Difficulty Options

We’ve refined AI decision-making as well, particularly during pit stops, making strategy more consistent and more realistic. On top of that, you’ll now be able to see which tire compounds your competitors are using, a small but impactful detail that adds another layer to race strategy.
Weather transitions and choiche of tires for the AI have also been tweaked, for a better experience.

For players looking for a tougher experience, this update introduces the new Very Hard difficulty mode, designed specifically for those who want the most challenging and demanding version of Formula Legends. The Very Easy mode, aimed at newcomers, will arrive in a future update.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/188493f4af596357d9d8a194d3fa9b2e938a1ab8.png"]
The New Custom Camera
Another major community request also makes its debut: the Custom Camera.
You can now adjust cockpit angle, field of view, distance, and more, and save your own presets.
It’s a powerful tool to tailor your perspective and make the game feel truly your own.
You can find the complete changelog here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3194360/discussions/0/682986292645022475/
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/15a6f61790d33cf7d8ba639cd4a9da2bbd7d3ce6.png"]The New Custom Configurarion

Based on the feedback we collected, we have completely rebuilt the Custom Configuration system from the ground up, including a newly rewritten engine module developed by 3DClouds. Thanks to the support of our graphics programmers, you are now free to use all your creations without limitations.

You can find the new guide https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cpc8NFiaK9O_87Kmh2IgZcTXY66VpxI2/view, or simply check out the video on our YouTube channel.[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QgJZJXN_lRU"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/8adcfa1d6be6432691a014bc6ee5f2d5922c9965.png"]Alongside the many fixes and improvements listed in the patch notes, we’ve also added an upgrade to shadows with a new Ultra Quality setting.
There’s one feature that has been requested more than anything else.
We can finally confirm that online multiplayer is REAL and it’s officially coming to Formula Legends, completely FREE in early 2026.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/7eefdefad15c5d03e08f2174d90f4fe0b6738466.png"]It’s a huge milestone for the game, and we’re incredibly excited to share more as development progresses.
Thank you for your support, your feedback, and your passion. Version 1.1 lands now and the journey ahead is just getting started.
See you on tracks, Legends!!

Our team is already hard at work on the next wave of updates, bringing even more depth and realism to Formula Legends.

Among the upcoming features, you can expect a completely new difficulty system with selectable tiers to better match your driving style, along with further refinements to AI behavior and collision physics (we need to redo all the balances of the cars) for a smoother, more authentic racing experience.

We’re also developing full steering wheel support, including manual gearbox functionality and expanding our graphics options , and DEMO will return Soon![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/f02acb2674d139e4fe2b1e8fa623a4c0ba7af605.png"]Stay tuned because the race has only just begun, Legends!
We’re excited to share that the first two weeks of Formula Legends have been a great success!
On behalf of the entire 3DClouds team, we want to say a huge thank you to everyone who played the game and shared their valuable feedback.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/c97280cf8516bc0a551a5864f83b172ac743223a.png"]
From your reports, two main areas stood out: steering and AI behavior.
We acted quickly to analyze your feedback in detail and are working hard to make Formula Legends the best possible experience for everyone.
The first step of this effort is a new patch, available today on Steam and next week on all other platforms.
Improved race AI: reduced aggressiveness, fewer crashes into the player, and better handling of corners to avoid collisions.
New optional steering system: more sensitive and responsive, designed for players who found the current model less comfortable.

⚠️ Important: this is not a replacement for the existing steering, which many of you have enjoyed. Players will be able to choose the model they prefer. When you start the game for the first time, it will show you some information about what has changed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/770ba92b54c410cb2865eb772695d541e13aa0f1.png"]In the Settings menu, you can adjust the driving model whenever you like.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/e9815694ccf54182edb02c64670125c0bc25871f.jpg"]

We’re aware that more responsive steering may lead to better performance on certain complex tracks. For this reason, with the next patch planned for mid/late October, we’ll be performing a leaderboard reset. We apologize in advance for this step, but it’s necessary given the nature of this change.

In that patch, we’ll also focus on further improving AI behavior, introducing new difficulty levels, rebalancing the existing ones, and addressing additional bugs to enhance the overall gameplay experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/4c4c5490bc6afde8fa8e67abe83258566b9f38b7.png"]
